description: A #270 reputation group record (src/data/core/honor/groups.json). Groups are world data; instances are authored with the world (owner slot). Thresholds vary per group as the design — a group omitting them inherits the standing grid's defaults.

effects.description: authored standingEffects rows keyed by standing label (TRANSFER-MAP §2.3: terms / rent / keys / sensors / teeth) — content, added with instances

hateThreshold.description: raw infamy at which the group has Hated the Ranger (hated floor); defaults to thresholds.range4

homeAreaId.description: #7 area ref the group is seated in (drives 'area'-reach tally credits and B1/B5 area reads)

seeThrough.description: reader class for the disguise read-lens (TRANSFER-MAP §2.5): officers/guards/trackers see through a presented identity

valence.description: normal, or swapped (the Syndicate reads infamy as fame) — the group declares its own reading

title: honor group record
